Show
Break ScheduleBreaks follow assignment order in two alternating groups. The first group matches the star-marked group on the facility whiteboard.
Assignment order
Each CNA row is an assignment/run number. CNA names are optional. Saved routines can predict who normally takes that assignment. Care Load points are advisory; the normal light-load limit is 2 assignments per shift. Choosing more requires a supervisor override confirmation because the remaining residents still have to be distributed fairly. A lighter assignment is calculated as part of the fair workload target from the start. “1 fewer” means one resident below the normal rounded-up target for that shift; it does not stack with the Workload Advisory button. For a call-off, Ordered Reassignment keeps the departing residents in strict room/bed order and gives consecutive blocks to the remaining Assignment numbers.

Interface modeSimple View shows one work area at a time. Full View keeps the richer all-at-once workspace for experienced users.

Automatic shift preparationAutomatic targeting is only a convenience for opening the likely current/upcoming shift. It never limits when DSD can prepare an assignment. Use Manual override or DSD Shift Planner for any date and any shift, including tomorrow or days/weeks ahead.
Current targetingCurrent shift

Workspace access

Owner/Admin manages the system. DSD / Scheduler can create daily assignments and monthly CNA schedules. Supervisor (LVN/RN desk nurse) can create daily assignments only. Viewers can review and print. Staff / Alerts accounts see only their own current finalized assignment and notification preference.

Add an account directly

Use this when you want to create an account yourself. For regular staff, the one-time invite flow below is usually easier.

Only needed for a truly new account. Existing accounts keep their password. Share a new password privately. Staff will choose their own personal 4–8 digit quick-login PIN after the first sign-in.

Generate Staff / Alerts invite

Create a one-time 6-digit invite code. The QR contains only the Cottage CareOps website address—the secret code is entered separately.

Use the same real name this person is known by on the CNA roster. The invite will require a matching name.

One-time staff invite
------
Share the QR/link and this code with the staff member.
QR = website only · invite code stays separate
Email Assignment Alerts

Optional. When a finalized assignment includes a Staff / Alerts account by name, Cottage CareOps schedules an email 10 minutes before that shift. If finalization happens inside the last 10 minutes, the alert is queued immediately. Room/resident details are never placed in the email.

Email provider not configured

Email/password authentication and staff accounts work without this provider. A configured email provider is required for assignment-alert emails, automatic emailed PIN-recovery codes, and secure in-app feedback delivery.
Feedback & Bug Report Delivery

Owner/Admin only. The destination email is stored in protected cloud configuration and is not shown on the normal feedback form. Change it here if the support contact changes.

Automatic cloud save is always on after the initial copy is resolved. Local saving remains available as a fast fallback, and conflict protection still pauses rather than silently overwriting a newer cloud copy.
Privacy: Keep resident names, diagnoses, medications, medical record numbers and other private health information out of this app. Cloud Sync does not make the app a HIPAA-compliant clinical record system.
Access & Device SecurityCloud account 2FA, optional device PIN, and shared-device auto-lock.2FA
⌄
Authenticator App Two-Factor AuthenticationFree TOTP security through Supabase Auth. Owner/Admin and DSD / Scheduler accounts must verify a 6-digit authenticator code. Supervisor, Viewer, and Staff / Alerts accounts may enable it voluntarily; once enabled, their future cloud sign-ins also require the authenticator.
Checking role…Checking 2FA…
Recommended recovery setup: Supabase TOTP does not provide recovery codes. After enabling 2FA, add a second backup authenticator factor on another trusted device/app. Never share the QR code or setup secret.
CareOps Device LockYour approved cloud account is the main authorization layer. Owner/Admin and DSD / Scheduler require authenticator-app 2FA; other roles may enable it voluntarily. The optional 4–8 digit device PIN is only a faster device-level lock/re-auth for a shared workstation.
Device PIN lock is off
How security works: cloud email/password + workspace membership control account access; Owner/Admin and DSD / Scheduler require 2FA. Supervisor, Viewer, and Staff / Alerts may enable 2FA voluntarily. The device PIN remains optional and device-specific, does not replace the password or 2FA, and does not encrypt browser storage. On shared computers, also use Lock or Sign Out and the computer’s own account/password protection.

Version History

v4.22.2 · Mobile State Paper Cards & Compliance-Safe Printing
  • Redesigned the DSD State Staffing Paper editor on iPhone as stacked staff cards so every field is visible without horizontal table scrolling. Desktop/iPad keep the wide editor while phones use a cleaner single-row card layout with compact two-column action controls.
  • Changed new State Paper rows so Actual Shift Start/End and Actual Meal Break Start/End begin blank. These fields represent actual worked/meal times and are entered only when known; the shift header still shows the scheduled shift start for reference.
  • Removed CareOps branding, audit/version footers, internal notes, and the custom disclaimer from the facility assignment-sheet printout so the printed page contains only the staffing form itself.
  • Added a direct Official CDPH 530 action. Current CDPH guidance requires the actual CDPH 530 for its mandated use and states modified/substantially similar versions are unacceptable; CareOps therefore does not mislabel its facility assignment sheet as the official state form.
  • Preserved finalized revision immutability, CNA assignment ordering, Observation/special-role grouping, nurses-last ordering, handwritten signature areas, and all v4.22.1 routing/sync fixes.
v4.22.1 · Full-Width State Paper Editor & Safe Preview Startup
  • Expanded the DSD State Staffing Paper editor to the same near-full-window footprint used by the CNA Monthly Calendar editor (up to 1500 px / 98vw), with a fixed modal frame, independently scrolling body, and full-screen tablet/mobile treatment.
  • Reduced unnecessary horizontal travel on narrower screens by treating Source and the on-screen signature reminder as secondary editor columns while preserving their underlying data and the handwritten-signature area on the printed form.
  • Added a branded secure startup fallback so limited HTML previewers no longer show a blank page while the authentication privacy shield is active. The real workspace remains hidden until normal authentication completes.
  • Updated visible build labels and security-screen version footers to v4.22.1. No assignment balancing, schedule data, cloud permissions, finalized-history rules, or State Paper print requirements were removed.
v4.22.0 · DSD State Paper Workflow & Generated-Assignment Sync
  • Made the DSD Shift Planner the operational hub: Prepare Assignment now opens the selected date/shift directly in Staff or the existing generated Assignment, while Open State Paper opens that exact shift without returning to the generic Shift front page.
  • Rebuilt State Paper row sourcing so the generated shift assignment is the primary source of truth. Regular CNAs follow Assignment 1, 2, 3… order with exact generated room/bed text; Observation, Shower, RNA/Restorative, and other special CNA roles follow; nursing rows print last in Charge/Desk, Cart 1, Cart 2, Cart 3, Treatment, Float/Other order.
  • Fixed the v4.21 State Paper linkage bug that could show repeated “Assignment not generated” placeholders even after an assignment existed. Existing State Paper drafts now safely resync after a newly generated/re-generated assignment while preserving actual shift/meal entries, No Meal selections, status edits, and manual-only rows.
  • Changed State Paper meal handling so Actual Meal Break Start/End begin blank and are never copied from the planned break rotation. Missing meal times are readiness warnings rather than automatic blocking errors so actual times can be entered after meals occur.
  • Changed readiness UX so merely opening or editing the paper shows a neutral draft message. Validation runs only from Check Readiness or Finalize, and missing assignments are summarized instead of repeating a placeholder on every CNA row.
  • Added direct navigation back to the DSD Shift Planner from Staff, Assignment, and State Paper, plus a Generate / Prepare Assignment First action when the current shift has no generated assignment.
  • Preserved finalized State Paper revisions as immutable snapshots, handwritten employee/DON signature areas, unrestricted advance planning, monthly CNA/Nursing schedule workflows, Observation-inclusive CNA staffing math, cloud/local persistence, authentication privacy protections, and prior history.
v4.21.0 · DON/ADON Nursing Calendar + Schedule-Driven DSD Rosters
  • Added a separate Nursing Monthly Schedule with the same month/shift workflow used for CNA scheduling: saved months, W/OFF/RO day cells, nurse directory selection, credential and usual nursing-role fields, JSON import, import template export, and printable calendar view.
  • Nursing schedule editing is reserved to Owner/Admin and DON/ADON/Nursing Supervisor cloud roles. DSD/Scheduler may view and use the nursing calendar for daily staffing but cannot change the official monthly nursing schedule.
  • Updated the DSD Shift Planner to show the exact saved calendar names for the selected date/shift, grouped in professional categories: Nursing, Floor CNAs, Observation, Shower, RNA/Restorative, and Extra/Special.
  • Added Use Scheduled Staff from the DSD planner. It remains optional: it loads the dated CNA roster plus scheduled nurses into that shift workspace, after which DSD can remove a call-off, select a replacement, add called-in/extra staff, or change nursing assignments without altering the monthly calendars.
  • Added LPT as a first-class nursing credential and kept nursing calendar data in local/cloud workspace backups. Existing CNA schedule ownership, assignment balancing, state-paper signatures, finalized history, and observation math are unchanged.
v4.20.2 · Professional Observation Terminology
  • Updated formal DSD/state-paper terminology so observation coverage prints as Observation rather than OBS or Sitter.
  • Observation remains an assignment/coverage designation; the employee’s actual discipline continues to print separately as CNA, RN, LVN, LPT, or other applicable credential.
  • Changed DSD staffing-category labels from OBS to Observation while preserving all existing observation-room, staffing-count, and assignment logic.
  • No staffing calculations, room assignments, employee signatures, finalized history, or cloud data behavior were changed.
v4.20.1 · Unrestricted DSD Advance Planning
  • Removed any implied timing restriction from DSD assignment preparation. DSD can prepare Day, Evening, or Night for any selected patient-day date regardless of the current time.
  • Confirmed the DSD planner date field has no minimum or maximum date lock, so assignments may be prepared tomorrow, several days ahead, weeks ahead, or farther in advance when operationally useful.
  • Renamed the Today-only wording to DSD Shift Planner and added Today, Tomorrow, and +7 Days shortcuts while keeping the date field fully editable.
  • Clarified that automatic shift-preparation windows are convenience suggestions only and never block manual/DSD planning.
  • Updated Day, Evening, and Night guidance so recommended preparation times are operational suggestions—not permissions or restrictions. Existing per-date/per-shift draft preservation, state-paper workflow, call-off handling, signatures, cloud persistence, and finalized history remain unchanged.
v4.20.0 · DSD Daily Shift Board & Ahead-of-Shift Preparation
  • Added a dedicated Today’s DSD Shift Board for the three normal shifts: Day 7 AM–3 PM, Evening 3 PM–11 PM, and Night 11 PM–7 AM. DSD can jump directly to any shift for the selected date instead of waiting for automatic shift targeting.
  • Added DSD-specific preparation guidance: Evening can be prepared a few hours before 3 PM and adjusted for call-offs before handoff; Night can be prepared and printed before DSD leaves around 5 PM even though the shift starts at 11 PM.
  • Added persistent multi-shift assignment workspaces so starting the Evening or Night assignment no longer wipes an unfinished roster/draft for another shift. Each date/shift keeps its own regular CNA roster, generated assignment draft, Observation/Sitter and Shower Team context until reopened.
  • The DSD board shows each shift’s assignment status, roster count, saved monthly-schedule count when available, and State Staffing Paper status, with direct buttons to prepare the assignment or open the paper.
  • Added a late-call-off workflow reminder: after DSD has left, staff can document any later staffing change on the printed paper according to facility policy, while CareOps preserves the DSD-issued electronic version and revision history.
  • Preserved employee handwritten-signature areas, Nursing Directory suggestions, finalized state-paper revisions, cloud persistence, OBS-inclusive staffing math, and all prior v4.19.2 behavior.
v4.19.2 · Employee Signature & Nurse Roster Workflow
  • Matched the facility sample more closely by labeling the DSD worksheet and printed state-paper column Employee Signature and placing a clear X signing marker in every printed employee-signature cell while leaving the rest of the cell blank for the employee's original handwritten signature.
  • Added a dedicated + Add Nurse action inside the DSD State Staffing Paper so DSD can add an RN/LVN directly without first leaving the state-paper workflow.
  • Added Nursing Directory/CNA name suggestions to the DSD employee-name field. RN/LVN names entered on the state-paper worksheet are remembered in the Nursing Directory after the field is committed, but are not automatically assigned to future shifts.
  • Changed state-paper nurse assignments to the facility-style labels Desk, Cart 1, Cart 2, Cart 3, Treatment, and Float / Other instead of long placeholder text.
  • Saved nursing assignments are now eligible to flow into the DSD state paper even when the optional Nursing Staff panel is currently hidden, preventing previously entered nurse names from disappearing from the finalized staffing paper.
  • Preserved v4.19.1's sample-matched print layout, finalized revision history, handwritten-signature requirement, CNA/OBS staffing logic, cloud persistence, and existing assignment workflow.
v4.19.1 · State Paper Sample Layout Match
  • Updated the finalized DSD State Staffing Paper printout to closely follow the facility/state sample supplied by Arnold: portrait letter format, numbered facility/date/DON/shift/unit fields, Shift 1/2/3 indicator, and the same compact sign-in table order.
  • Changed the printed table to Nursing Services Assignment, Employee Name, Discipline, Actual Shift Start/End, Actual Meal/Break Start/End, and Employee Signature. CareOps still keeps richer source/status details internally without cluttering the signed paper.
  • Combined start/end values and meal/break values into the same paper columns used by the sample while preserving exact time fields in the editable DSD workflow.
  • Added a sample-style DON/designee verification statement and signature line. Employee and DON/designee signature areas remain blank for original handwritten signatures.
  • Mapped CareOps Day / Evening / Night to paper Shift 1 / 2 / 3 and kept revision/finalization audit information in small footer text without presenting the CareOps sheet as an official state-agency form.
  • Preserved v4.19.0 state-paper history, revisions, readiness checks, cloud persistence, nursing/CNA/direct-care roster building, and all earlier stabilization fixes.
v4.19.0 · DSD Finalized State Staffing Paper
  • Expanded the DSD staffing worksheet into a complete state-paper workflow: Prepare, verify actual staffing, Finalize, preserve a locked revision in History, and print for original employee and DON/designee signatures.
  • Added persistent state-paper drafts and finalized paper history to local backups and cloud workspace payloads, keyed by patient-day date and shift.
  • Added automatic RN/LVN/CNA/direct-care roster building from the current CNA assignments, Observation / Sitter coverage, Shower Team, Other / Special CNA Role, and Nursing Staff, plus manual Add Direct-Care Staff rows for registry, relief, or other qualifying caregivers.
  • Added required/readiness checks for facility, unit/location, DON/designee, full employee name, discipline, specific nursing assignment, actual start/end times, and meal start/end or No meal. Placeholder assignments must be corrected before finalization.
  • Added call-off/vacancy/correction notes, discipline totals, beginning census, shift start time, assignment-finalization linkage, finalized-by/date/time/revision metadata, and immutable revision history.
  • Added Reopen / New Revision so staffing changes can be corrected without overwriting the earlier finalized paper. Previous revisions remain available to view and reprint from History.
  • Printing now uses the locked finalized snapshot, labels it as a facility-created Nursing Staffing Assignment & Sign-In Sheet, leaves original signature fields blank, and includes DON/designee verification/signature lines. Finalizing in CareOps is not treated as an employee or DON signature.
  • Preserved all v4.18.0 stabilization fixes, cloud/auth protections, assignment history, monthly schedules, OBS-inclusive staffing math, and existing assignment printing.
v4.18.0 · Daily Staffing Sign-In Worksheet & Stabilization Release
  • Added a new Daily Staffing & Sign-In worksheet for DSD / Scheduler and daily-assignment workflows. It auto-fills the prepared shift, date, census, floor CNA room/bed assignments, Observation / Sitter coverage, Other / Special CNA roles, Shower Team context, and optional Nursing Staff already entered in CareOps.
  • Added editable staffing-document fields for facility/location, DON or designee, preparer, employee discipline, exact nursing assignment, shift start/end, meal start/end, employment status, and a blank original-signature line for each employee.
  • Added a print-isolated landscape document so the staffing worksheet prints by itself without exposing the live CareOps workspace. The printed page contains no resident names and includes DON/designee verification and signature lines.
  • Added direct access from Review & Finalize and More Tools, plus Refresh From Current Shift so the worksheet can be regenerated after staffing or assignment changes.
  • Added an official CDPH 530 link and a clear compliance notice: the CareOps worksheet is a preparation/working copy and does not claim to replace the current official CDPH 530 when that form is required.
  • Preserved the v4.17.1 total-CNA/Observation floor math, v4.17.2 authentication privacy shield, optional manual preload behavior, saved monthly schedules, password recovery, cloud roles, assignment balancing, finalized History, and existing assignment printing.
v4.17.2 · Secure Sign-In Screen & Workspace Privacy Fix
  • Fixed the mobile sign-in bug where the main CareOps workspace could remain visible underneath the cloud sign-in card before authentication.
  • Added a true authentication shield that hides and makes the main workspace non-interactive until the cloud account is verified, including during sign-in, password recovery, MFA, Staff invite/PIN screens, and Device PIN lock.
  • Hardened iPhone/iPad auth screens to fill the dynamic viewport with their own opaque scroll surface so scrolling the sign-in card cannot reveal staffing, census, assignment, or schedule content behind it.
  • Kept the shield active while a saved cloud session is being re-verified on startup; previously verified non-staff accounts can still use the existing offline fallback when allowed.
  • Preserved cloud roles, MFA requirements, Staff / Alerts portal behavior, password recovery, Device PIN recovery, monthly schedules, staffing logic, printing, and finalized History.
v4.17.1 · Observation-Inclusive Staffing & iPhone Calendar Print Isolation
  • Corrected daily staffing math so Staffing Target is the total CNA headcount. Observation CNAs are included inside that total instead of being added on top.
  • Floor Target now subtracts active Observation coverage and saved non-floor special roles. Example: Total CNA Target 9 with 2 Observation rooms produces Floor Target 7.
  • Floor Scheduled now reserves Observation positions even when an older/imported monthly schedule marked all working CNAs as Floor and did not identify the sitter names.
  • Preload Scheduled CNAs now loads only the floor-sized roster. Explicit monthly OBS names still preload into Observation / Sitter; when the monthly schedule does not identify who should cover OBS, CareOps leaves those names for the supervisor instead of guessing.
  • Added an Observation note showing how many CNA positions are already included in the Total CNA Target but still need sitter placement.
  • Reworked Monthly CNA Schedule printing for iPhone/iPad so the live CareOps workspace is physically detached during the print snapshot. Only the monthly calendar remains in the print document, preventing assignment/navigation pages from leaking into Print / Save PDF.

v4.17.0 · Saved Month History, Floor Staffing & Cloud Recovery
  • Removed the 72-schedule cap from normalization, import, editor saves, and bundled-data merging. All retained months remain in local backups and cloud payloads until explicitly archived; previously deleted months require a backup or protected archive restore.
  • Added all-saved-month selectors and obvious previous/next calendar navigation, including clear empty-month states. Unsaved editor changes require confirmation before switching months.

Undo restores staffing and special-role visibility.
  • Saved monthly role badges now reflect the saved schedule instead of being silently replaced by later finalized assignment roles.
  • Added Forgot password, recovery email, verified Create New Password and authenticator support. Recovery credentials are removed from the URL, held only in memory, and never open the workspace; users sign in normally after resetting. Change My Password remains available in Settings and the signed-in account menu.
  • Added server-authorized Send Password Reset for the owner and DSD / Scheduler managers (lower-role accounts only). Existing role edits, removal, invites, email settings, staff PINs and MFA policies stay with the existing management service.
  • Re-adding an email now searches existing Auth accounts first and atomically relinks workspace membership without changing the existing password or an active member role. A password is required only when creating a truly new account.
  • Supplied an additive account-recovery Edge Function and SQL setup with active-session checks, protected owner handling, reset throttling, and durable admin audit records containing no passwords or recovery tokens. Requires deployment and Supabase Auth redirect/SMTP setup. Temporary-password override is intentionally omitted; secure recovery email is the supported assisted-reset path.

DSD / Scheduler can create daily CNA assignments and create/edit/import monthly CNA schedules; Supervisor (LVN/RN desk nurse) can create and manage daily CNA assignments but cannot change monthly CNA schedule history.

Existing legacy manual schedules whose targets exactly mirrored every scheduled count are treated as legacy mirrored targets and shown with an independent planning target instead.

v4.16.5 · Learned Next-Month Schedule Suggestions
  • Added a DSD / Scheduler “Suggest Next Month” workflow that learns from recent saved/imported schedules instead of relying only on CNA Directory weekdays.

v4.16.1 · Cloud Save 405 Fix
  • Replaced direct Data REST PATCH workspace writes with an authenticated Supabase RPC that saves through POST, avoiding the browser/Data API 405 Method Not Allowed failure path.
  • Preserved optimistic concurrency protection: the server updates only when the cloud workspace timestamp still matches the version this device loaded, so a newer save from another device is not silently overwritten.
  • The new save function runs as SECURITY INVOKER, remains subject to existing workspace RLS and 2FA requirements, grants execution only to authenticated users, and denies anonymous execution.
  • Automatic retry, local pending-change protection, recovery copies, owner-only force replacement, viewer/staff read-only behavior, and normal cloud conflict handling remain intact.

v4.15.4 · Mobile Staff Invite Navigation Fix
  • Fixed the one-time Staff Invite screen on iPhone/mobile so a tall registration form scrolls inside its own full-screen layer instead of visually spilling over the app underneath.
  • Added an always-visible Back to Sign In control and an × close button at the top of the Staff Invite flow.
  • Both controls safely return to cloud sign-in, clear sensitive invite/password form values, and remove the ?join=1 URL flag so reopening/reloading does not trap the device back in the invite screen.
  • Hidden the mobile Generate / Review / Print bar while Staff Invite onboarding is active, preventing the underlying workspace controls from appearing below the registration card.
  • On mobile, Staff Invite fields now use a single-column layout for cleaner spacing and reliable scrolling with iPhone safe-area insets.
  • No staff invite security, Supabase account creation, CNA matching, alerts, PIN setup, 2FA, schedules, assignments, Nursing Staff, history/recovery, or printing logic changed.
v4.15.3 · Collapsible Nursing Staff Panel
  • Added a clear Collapse / Expand control to the main Nursing Staff panel on the Staff screen.
  • The collapsed state is remembered on the current device so mobile and desktop users can keep the nursing section compact between visits.
  • Collapsing Nursing Staff is display-only: nurse names, cart assignments, Nursing Directory data, prediction history, and finalized/printed nursing information are preserved.
  • Viewer accounts may still collapse or expand the panel while nursing-edit controls remain read-only.
  • No CNA workload balancing, nurse prediction logic, schedules, cloud sync, 2FA, secure feedback, secure history/recovery, finalization, or printing logic changed.
v4.15.2 · Secure Feedback & Cloud Password Verification
  • Fixed secure Bug Report/Feedback delivery where the server could send the email but then fail its success response with “supportLabel is not defined.”
  • Added the missing protected feedback-config response so the app can load the administrator-defined CareOps Support label and instructions without exposing the destination email.
  • Cloud password changes now require the user to enter and successfully verify the current cloud password before a new password is accepted.
  • The app also submits the current password with the Supabase password-update request; an already-open CareOps session alone is no longer sufficient for this in-app password-change workflow.
  • Current-password values are never stored in CareOps local storage or cloud workspace data and the password fields are cleared after each attempt.
  • Corrected remaining active lock/login/2FA/staff footer labels to the current app version. No staffing, schedule, rebalance, prediction, finalization, secure-history, or print logic changed.
v4.15.1 · Smart Rebalance Menu Cleanup
  • Removed three old Version History release-note blocks that were accidentally embedded inside the Smart Rebalance Preview modal.
  • Smart Rebalance Preview now contains only the before/after workload summary, impact details, and reassignment changes that belong to the rebalance workflow.
  • Version History remains available only in its proper Version History/About location.
  • No rebalance calculations, room-order/minimal-change logic, CNA workload rules, cloud sync, 2FA, secure history archive/recovery, schedules, finalization, or printing logic changed.
v4.15.0 · Secure History Archive & Recovery
  • Changed Clear History into a protected cloud-first operation. Its scope remains limited to finalized assignment history and the visible audit log; imported staff schedules are not cleared by this action.
  • Imported staff schedules now use a separate Archive action instead of direct removal. The authoritative cloud schedule entry is archived server-side before it is removed from active prediction history.
  • Added Cloud Archive & Recovery in History. Creator/Admin and Supervisor accounts can review protected archive metadata and restore missing historical records.
  • Destructive/archive/restore actions require an authorized Creator/Admin or Supervisor account, an online cloud session, and a fresh authenticator-app 2FA challenge. If the optional local Supervisor Device PIN is enabled, it is also required before the cloud verification step.
  • The browser does not supply the backup payload. The secure server function reads the authoritative cloud workspace, writes the archive first, then applies the requested change with optimistic concurrency protection so another device cannot be silently overwritten.
  • Recovery is non-destructive: it adds missing records only. Existing records and newer schedule data win; restoring an archived schedule will not replace a current schedule for the same month and shift.
  • Added a separate server-side security audit for archive, clear, and restore operations. Ordinary users cannot write archive/audit rows directly.
  • Preserved v4.14.3 shift override/night behavior, 2FA, cloud sync, CNA Directory, prediction logic, Nursing Staff, finalization, printing, imported assignment history, and bundled September schedules.
v4.14.3 · Shift Override & Night-Shift QA
  • Fixed the top Shift Override workflow so enabling manual preparation no longer silently jumps to an old/default Day selection.
  • Tapping Override now opens a focused Date + Shift picker with all three choices visible: Day (7–3), Evening (3–11), and Night (11–7).
  • The picker starts from the shift currently being shown, so overriding from Evening starts on Evening instead of unexpectedly switching to Day. Existing manual selections remain selected when reopening the picker.
  • Clarified Night date handling: the selected date is the date the 11 PM night shift starts.
  • Verified automatic boundaries: Night becomes the upcoming shift at 8 PM, current at 11 PM, remains the active shift after midnight, and Day becomes the upcoming shift at 4 AM. The NEXT SHIFT badge distinguishes preparation from the shift currently in progress.
  • Verified the bundled September 2026 Night schedule is still used as exact roster authority under manual Night override; Sep 11 resolves to 8 scheduled CNAs.
  • No resident assignment engine, CNA schedule bundle, 2FA, cloud sync, finalization, printing, or Nursing Staff logic was changed.
v4.14.2 · 2FA Database Permission Fix
  • Fixed a Supabase Row Level Security regression that could show “permission denied for table mfa_factors” immediately after authenticator-app 2FA enrollment.
  • Moved the verified-factor lookup behind a protected helper in the private database schema instead of allowing normal app sessions to read Supabase’s internal Auth factor table directly.
  • Verified Owner/Admin security behavior: an AAL1 password-only session cannot open the privileged workspace, while an AAL2 session that completed the authenticator challenge can access it normally.
  • Owner/Admin and Supervisor 2FA enforcement remains required. Viewer/Staff accounts that voluntarily enroll 2FA continue to be challenged by the app and protected server-side where applicable.
  • No CNA schedules, resident census, assignments, nursing data, directory profiles, finalized history, print logic, or bundled September schedules were changed by this backend security patch.
v4.14.1 · Mobile Startup & Interaction Fix
  • Fixed a startup JavaScript regression that could leave the app looking loaded while buttons, tabs, Settings, History, Generate, and other controls did nothing when tapped or clicked.
  • Restored the accidentally omitted core UI helpers (toast/modal controls), shift-context helpers, and CNA name datalist renderer, allowing startup and all button/tab event handlers to complete on mobile and desktop.
  • Preserved the v4.14.0 authenticator-app 2FA flow, v4.13 Directory Manager and secure feedback, bundled September schedules, prediction logic, cloud sync, finalization, printing, and mobile/desktop CNA autocomplete.
  • No CNA schedule, assignment-history, resident census, nursing, or security data was intentionally changed by this patch.
v4.14.0 · Free Authenticator 2FA & Privileged Account Protection
  • Added free authenticator-app (TOTP) two-factor authentication using Supabase Auth; no SMS provider, Twilio, or paid MFA feature is required.
  • Owner/Admin and Supervisor accounts must enroll and verify 2FA before opening the cloud workspace. Viewer and Staff / Alerts accounts may enable 2FA voluntarily; once enrolled, their future cloud sign-ins require the authenticator code.
  • Added guided QR-code enrollment, manual setup-secret fallback, 6-digit verification, login challenge, account 2FA status, and a Manage 2FA screen with support for backup authenticator factors.
  • Added protection against removing the last verified authenticator from an Owner/Admin or Supervisor account. Supabase does not provide TOTP recovery codes, so the app recommends a separate backup factor.
  • Scoped workspace RLS so AAL2 is enforced for Creator/Supervisor cloud access without unnecessarily forcing Viewer accounts into 2FA. Owner/Admin account-management endpoints now also require an AAL2 session.
  • Privileged offline access now requires a previously 2FA-verified session; otherwise internet is required to complete 2FA. The local device PIN remains a separate shared-device convenience lock.
  • Retained the v4.13 Directory Manager, secure feedback, September schedule bundles, exact-schedule authority, OFF/RO handling, short-staffing redistribution, optional Nursing Staff, assignment-photo history, cloud sync, finalization/printing, and mobile/desktop CNA autocomplete.
v4.13.0 · Directory Manager, Secure Feedback & Device Security
  • Redesigned Manage CNA Directory around instant search, shift/day/status filters, compact people rows, a focused editor, and a Weekly Schedule view so supervisors can update routines without scrolling through every CNA card.
  • Weekly Schedule edits change only the CNA Directory’s usual routine; imported dated schedules remain authoritative for exact dates and are never rewritten by routine edits.
  • Replaced the hard-coded visible feedback email with authenticated secure cloud submission. Normal users see only the CareOps Support label; the destination address stays in protected admin configuration.
  • Added Owner/Admin feedback settings for destination email, support label, subject prefix, user-facing instructions, and enable/pause control. Reporters may optionally include their signed-in email for follow-up; it is off by default.
  • Feedback technical details no longer include a local file path or Windows user folder. No resident data, room assignment details, or login email are added automatically.
  • Updated the outdated standalone-only security wording. Cloud account membership is the authorization layer; the optional device PIN is a device-level convenience lock/re-auth and does not encrypt browser storage.
  • Strengthened newly saved device PINs with salted PBKDF2-SHA256 when browser cryptography is available. Existing legacy PINs remain usable and upgrade after successful verification; a compatibility fallback remains for unsupported browsers.
  • Retained bundled September Evening/Night schedules, exact-schedule authority, OFF/RO handling, short-staffing redistribution, optional Nursing Staff, assignment-photo history, cloud sync, finalization, print behavior, and mobile/desktop CNA autocomplete.
v4.12.6 · Consolidated September Schedule Data & Regression QA
  • Bundled the verified September 2026 Evening (3–11 PM) and Night (11 PM–7 AM) CNA schedules directly into the app so a fresh or cloud-loaded workspace can recover the known schedule data without requiring the separate JSON files.
  • Bundled schedules merge non-destructively: an existing schedule for the same month and shift is preserved, so supervisor corrections or a newer import are never overwritten by the built-in copy.
  • Bundled schedule rows seed missing CNA Directory profiles and only fill missing routine hints; manually configured names, routines, preferred assignments, and notes remain untouched.
  • Verified all 30 daily CNA totals for both bundled schedules against their source transcriptions. Request Off remains a date-specific exception and is excluded from routine learning.
  • Rechecked exact-schedule roster authority, short-staffing counts, assignment-photo placement history, optional Nursing Staff with three default med carts, hidden special CNA role behavior, mobile/desktop autocomplete, backup/cloud preservation, finalization, printing, and active version labels.
  • No resident clinical information is bundled. The schedule bundle contains staff scheduling/status data only.
v4.12.5 · Desktop CNA Autocomplete QA
  • Completed a dedicated desktop autocomplete regression test covering mouse selection, Arrow Up/Down + Enter, Escape, switching between multiple CNA fields, dynamic Staff rendering, and viewport placement.
  • Capped the desktop suggestion popup at a readable 520 px instead of allowing it to stretch across a wide Staff card.
  • Refined touch-layout detection so ordinary desktop and touchscreen Windows systems with a precise primary pointer keep the desktop popup, while phones/tablets and coarse-pointer touch devices retain the inline mobile suggestion layout.
  • Desktop autocomplete continues to suggest after the first typed character and the searchable Choose from directory fallback is unchanged.
  • No CNA scheduling, OFF/RO, room balancing, nursing, cloud, finalization, or print-assignment logic was changed.
v4.12.4 · Mobile CNA Autocomplete Reliability
  • Fixed intermittent CNA name suggestions on iPhone/iPad by avoiding fragile fixed-position popup behavior while the mobile keyboard and visual viewport are moving.
  • On touch/mobile devices, matching CNA names now render directly beneath the active CNA field; desktop keeps the compact floating suggestion popup.
  • Autocomplete now responds after the first typed character, safely handles mobile composition/autocorrect events, retries after keyboard viewport changes, and delays focus-out closing to prevent tap races.
  • Added click/touch selection fallbacks, disabled browser spellcheck/autocorrect on CNA name fields, and retained the searchable Choose from directory fallback.
  • No CNA schedule, OFF/RO, room-balancing, nursing, cloud, finalization, or print-assignment logic was changed.
v4.12.3 · Version Label Consistency
  • Corrected the persistent page footer that still displayed v4.11.0 even though the active build was v4.12.2.
  • Aligned the current sidebar badge, print header, local/cloud login screens, personal PIN screen, footer, and internal APP_VERSION to v4.12.3.
  • Historical Version History entries remain unchanged so earlier releases are still documented accurately.
  • No staffing, prediction, assignment, nursing, cloud, finalization, or print-layout logic was changed.
v4.12.2 · QA & Prediction Priority Fixes
  • Fixed assignment-history schema v2 accepting a completely empty file. Nursing-only history remains valid, but a file with no CNA assignments and no nursing roles is now rejected.
  • Fixed the Nursing Directory credential option Other being normalized back to LVN/RN during import or reload.
  • Restored exact imported staff schedule authority when a same-date old-assignment import also exists. The schedule controls who is working and the roster count; old-assignment history is used only for placement evidence unless the rare special-role option is explicitly enabled.
  • Prevented special-role-only assignment-photo rows from being learned as normal room-assignment history, and prevented hidden special-role history from reducing the normal regular-CNA count.
  • Fixed the optional Nursing Staff print block so it does not print “Not used” when Nursing Staff is disabled.
  • Rechecked startup, major modal/button handlers, Nursing toggle/cart rendering, assignment-photo import review, JavaScript syntax, and duplicate element IDs. Core resident balancing, OFF/RO handling, finalization, cloud roles, and print layout remain otherwise unchanged.
v4.12.1 · CNA Special-Role Cleanup
  • Removed Float / Relief CNA from the normal Staff workflow because Catered Cottage usually assigns working CNAs to regular room groups.
  • Replaced it with a rare-use Other / Special CNA Role that is hidden by default and can be enabled from Settings only when an unusual non-room CNA role is actually needed.
  • Normal short staffing now continues to mean fewer regular CNAs sharing the current room workload; hidden special-role history no longer reduces the suggested regular CNA assignment count.
  • Retained backwards compatibility with v4.12 assignment-history JSON that used the internal float placement type, but presents it as an optional special role rather than an everyday staffing category.
  • Nursing Staff, three medication carts, assignment-photo history, exact-schedule priority, staffing-count/census-aware room patterns, workload balancing, printing, cloud sync, and finalized history remain unchanged.
v4.12.0 · Flexible Staffing Patterns & Optional Nursing Staff
  • Added an optional Nursing Staff workspace with a simple three-cart default: Med Cart 1, Med Cart 2, and Med Cart 3, plus optional Charge / Desk, Treatment Nurse, and Float / Other roles.
  • Added a separate RN/LVN Nursing Directory with usual shift, workdays, usual cart/role, credential label, active/inactive status, and editable current-shift nursing assignments. Nursing history remains separate from CNA workload balancing.
  • Extended old-assignment imports to accept schema version 2 with optional nursing roles, CNA float/relief rows, census, and total-CNA context. Schema version 1 imports remain supported.
  • Added an optional Float / Relief CNA field that is not counted as a room-assignment CNA, so a true float does not artificially reduce the resident workload target.
  • Staffing predictions can now learn different room-assignment patterns for different staffing levels and census conditions. When reliable history shows that a scheduled CNA usually floats under the same staffing configuration, the suggested regular-assignment count can adapt while keeping the float separate.
  • Placement history now gives extra weight to records with a matching room-assignment count / total staffing context, while exact schedules and date-specific OFF/RO remain the strongest roster evidence.
  • Fixed a v4.11.0 strict-mode startup regression where the new staffing suggestion planner was assigned without a declaration, which could stop clean-browser initialization.
  • Finalized shifts preserve optional nursing and float assignments for future pattern learning. Existing resident eligibility, fair workload distribution, Ordered Reassignment, observation/shower coverage, break rotation, cloud roles, and finalization protections remain unchanged.
v4.11.0 · Assignment Photo History & Smarter Placement Predictions
  • Added More / Settings / History entry points for importing old CNA assignment sheets after ChatGPT converts a photo into Cottage CareOps Assignment History JSON.
  • Imported assignment history stores date, shift, CNA, assignment number, and visible room/bed area while keeping it separate from finalized in-app History.
  • Staff prediction now gives an exact imported work schedule priority over saved routines and historical patterns; OFF and request-off remain date-specific exclusions.
  • When no exact schedule exists, prediction can use saved routines, imported schedule patterns, finalized assignments, and imported old-assignment history as progressively weaker evidence.
  • Suggested roster details now show source, usual area, High/Medium/Low confidence, and the reason for the placement suggestion before a supervisor applies it.
  • Historical room/area learning is advisory only. Census eligibility, fair resident distribution, Ordered Reassignment, care-load guidance, observation/shower coverage, breaks, finalization, printing, cloud roles, and email alerts are unchanged.
v4.10.4 · Directory Selection
  • Choose from directory beside CNA name fields opens an alphabetical, searchable picker with 20 names per page.
  • Type-ahead suggestions remain available. Cancelling leaves the assignment name unchanged.
v4.10.3 · CNA Name Autocomplete
  • Type two or more letters to see up to five matching active CNA directory names.
  • Select by touch, mouse, or arrow keys and Enter. Empty fields never show the full directory.
  • Partial first names, last names, and accents are supported. New names can still be entered manually.
v4.10.2 · Conflict Protection & Recovery
  • Added cloud conflict review with a local backup download and confirmed cloud replacement.
  • Preserved recovery copies before cloud updates, backup imports, and recovery restores.
  • Added backup reminders and visible notices when saved data cannot be loaded.
  • Strengthened version checks and protected in-flight cloud pulls against local edits.
v4.10.0 · Staff Schedule Import & Prediction History
  • Added More → Import Schedule and a matching Settings shortcut for importing Cottage CareOps schedule JSON files created from staff-schedule photos.
  • Added a Review Import step that validates month/shift/day data, summarizes CNA/work/RO counts, automatically matches exact CNA names, and lets supervisors manually resolve possible spelling matches before saving.
  • Imported schedules now save CNA work, off, request-off, daily staffing-total, and source-pattern history. RO dates are one-date exceptions and are excluded from routine-learning calculations.
  • New CNA profiles can be created from an import. Existing profiles are reused when names match, while manually saved routine/shift information is preserved instead of being silently overwritten.
  • Staff prediction can now use imported schedule history in addition to CNA Directory routines and finalized assignment history, and predicted CNA count can use historical staffing totals while still expanding to fit all predicted names.
  • Added Imported Staff Schedules to History, duplicate month/shift replacement protection, removable import history, cloud-sync/backup compatibility, and audit entries for schedule imports.
  • No resident census, assignment distribution, Ordered Reassignment, care-load, observation/shower, break rotation, finalization, printing, Staff / Alerts, email-provider, or role-security logic was changed.
v4.9.0 · Assignment Guidance, Staff Name Matching & Live Update Alerts
  • Added configurable workload-guidance settings: supervisors can show or hide the Workload Advisory, show or hide lighter-load recommendations on generated assignment cards, and optionally let Generate automatically apply up to two recommended −1 lighter assignments.
  • Automatic lighter-load generation is off by default, preserves manual lighter-load choices, and uses the existing optional care-load and sitter-relief advisory logic rather than changing the underlying resident eligibility rules.
  • Added a Shift Summary preference for More shift details: Always open, Collapsible with remembered state, or Hidden. Existing users default to Always open.
  • Strengthened Staff Invite registration so the CNA enters the real staff/roster name used by the administrator; the invite name is authoritative and mismatched names are rejected.
  • Registered Staff / Alerts display names now synchronize into the CNA Directory for Admin/Supervisor workspaces, improving automatic roster-name matching without exposing login email addresses.
  • Expanded assignment alerts so a re-finalized revision during an active shift is queued immediately. Updated-assignment emails clearly tell staff to review the newest assignment and not rely on an older screenshot or printout.
  • The Staff / Alerts portal now checks for finalized assignment changes automatically while open and visibly reports when a newer revision is loaded.
  • Improved mobile printing so phone/tablet screen responsiveness no longer collapses the paper print layout; printed handoffs keep the compact paper-optimized assignment and information grids.
  • Preserved census eligibility, ordered reassignment, observation/shower coverage, break rotation, finalization/history, cloud conflict protection, role restrictions, personal PIN recovery, and v4.7.5+ isolated-print reliability.
v4.8.0 · Named Accounts, Staff Access & Email Alerts
  • Added display names to cloud accounts and a compact signed-in user chip showing the current person and role without exposing the login email in the normal header.
  • Added a restricted Staff / Alerts role that cannot read or edit the full shared workspace and instead receives a dedicated view of only that staff member’s current finalized assignment.
  • Added one-time 6-digit Staff Invite codes with configurable expiration, optional email binding, revocation, and a Join QR/link that contains only the website address—not the secret invite code.
  • Added personal 4–8 digit Staff PIN quick login on recognized devices. PINs are salted/hashed locally, never shown to administrators, and can be invalidated by an admin reset.
  • Added automatic emailed PIN-recovery verification codes when an email provider is configured, while email + password remains the strong fallback credential.
  • Added optional assignment email alerts scheduled 10 minutes before a finalized shift, or immediately when finalization occurs inside that window. Alert emails contain no room/resident details and link staff back to Cottage CareOps.
  • Added owner-only email-provider settings and test delivery, per-staff alert preferences, invite/user management, and alert scheduling backed by Supabase database jobs.
  • Preserved CNA distribution, census, workload, Ordered Reassignment, sitter/shower logic, break rotation, print design, finalized History, and existing Admin/Supervisor cloud synchronization.
v4.7.6 · Cleaner Break Schedule Labels
  • Simplified Break Schedule wording so the word “Assignment” is no longer repeated before every run number.
  • Printed, copied, reviewed, and History break summaries now use concise group wording such as “★ 3:00 AM — Assignments 1, 3, 5, 7” and “3:30 AM — Assignments 2, 4, 6.”
  • Updated the on-screen Break Schedule to show assignment numbers cleanly while still preserving optional CNA names.
  • Kept the v4.7.5 isolated print-document fix, printer-safe icons, assignment logic, break rotation times, cloud sync, permissions, and saved-data format unchanged.
v4.7.5 · Isolated Print Sheet Reliability Fix
  • Replaced direct printing of the live app screen with a dedicated assignment-only print document, so Guided/Review navigation, cloud status, buttons, and review controls cannot leak into the printed handoff even if a browser ignores or snapshots print-media CSS incorrectly.
  • Added a clean assignment-only print-preview document that automatically opens the system print dialog when supported; if a browser leaves the preview tab open, the tab itself contains only the printable handoff with no app controls to leak onto paper.
  • Kept the v4.7.4 professional handoff design: Catered Cottage branding, Draft/Finalized status, shift/date/timestamp summary, two-column assignment cards, room/bed details, break badges, and printer-safe icons.
  • Preserved One CNA per page, room/bed detail toggle, Small/Normal/Large print text sizes, finalized timestamps, reprint metadata, and all existing assignment/census/cloud/security behavior.
  • No CNA distribution, census values, workload calculations, call-off/rebalance logic, sitter/shower logic, break rotation, finalization, permissions, cloud sync, or saved-data schema changed.
v4.7.4 · Print Handoff Redesign & Guided Print Fix
  • Fixed a Guided/Simple View print-cascade bug that could hide the Assignment section and produce a blank or incomplete printout when printing from Shift, Census, Staff, or Review.
  • Redesigned the normal CNA handoff with a cleaner Catered Cottage header, clear Draft/Finalized status, shift/date/timestamp summary, compact two-column assignment cards, and stronger room/bed readability.
  • Added printer-safe inline icons for assignment cards, Shower Team, Break Schedule, Observation / Sitter, and At Hospital without requiring internet fonts or external image files.
  • Kept One CNA per page, Include room/bed details, and Small/Normal/Large print-text preferences working with the new layout.
  • Updated finalized History reprints to use matching branded print styling and clearer finalized/reprinted metadata.
  • No census values, CNA distribution, Ordered Reassignment, workload calculations, Observation / Sitter logic, Shower Team logic, break rotation, finalization, cloud sync, permissions, or saved-data structure changed.
Cottage CareOps · September 10, 2026
  • New CareOps branding, compact dashboard, navy navigation, colorful workflow cards, icons, and stronger typography.
  • Consistent Blue, Teal, Graphite, and Amber themes across Guided and Overview modes, with saved preferences.
  • Clear Override on/off appearance and smaller shift summary numbers.
  • Owner-only Manage Users: add accounts, assign Supervisor or Viewer access, change roles, and remove cloud workspace access.
  • My Cloud Account allows signed-in users to change their password.
  • Fixed reopening finalized assignments when no device PIN is configured: verified Admin/Supervisor access plus confirmation is used. Configured PINs remain required.
  • Original assignment algorithms, storage compatibility, history, backups, and print layout retained.
v4.7.3 · Cloud Reliability, Read-Only Roles & Update Awareness
  • Added offline startup for previously authenticated devices: a temporary internet/Supabase outage no longer discards the saved session or blocks access to the local workspace.
  • Added a persistent pending-cloud-change marker. If the app is closed before the normal automatic upload finishes, the next authenticated launch automatically retries that unsynced local change.
  • Added true viewer-mode UI protection. Approved viewer accounts can browse, search, review, print, and export but shared-data editing controls are disabled, while Supabase RLS remains the server-side enforcement layer.
  • Added a compact mobile cloud-health strip showing synced, saving, offline, sign-in-required, or action-needed states so cloud conflicts are no longer hidden on phones.
  • Added a Last cloud save indicator in Cloud Settings for quick confirmation of the most recent successful upload from the current device.
  • Added automatic hosted-version checks with an Update available — Reload notice when a newer Catered Cottage build is deployed at the same website address.
  • New audit entries identify the approved signed-in cloud account/role, including Arnold’s Creator account, instead of relying only on Local user/Supervisor labels.
  • Preserved v4.7.2 mobile header polish, automatic cloud sync, conflict protection, local fallback, assignment logic, Review / Finalize, History, and printing.
v4.7.2 · Mobile Control Polish & Simple-View Cleanup
  • Redesigned the iPhone Simple / Full view controls into a tighter mobile-friendly segmented toggle so they no longer look oversized.
  • Converted the separate More control into a compact icon-style button on phones to reduce header crowding while keeping More Tools one tap away.
  • Improved top-bar spacing and button sizing on narrow screens so the Catered Cottage header feels cleaner and more balanced.
  • Fixed the mobile Settings / History overlap by hiding the bottom Generate / Review / Print bar while those administrative sections are open.
  • Reduced extra bottom spacing in mobile administrative sections so settings are easier to reach without controls covering them.
  • Updated cloud login wording to be less technical while keeping the secure managed cloud connection behavior unchanged.
  • No CNA assignment distribution, census logic, staffing rules, Review / Finalize workflow, History records, or Supabase security permissions changed.
v4.7.1 · Reliable Automatic Cloud Sync
  • Confirmed that every normal workspace save still writes locally immediately and automatically queues a Supabase upload without requiring a Sync button.
  • Added automatic retry for temporary network/server failures so a brief connection problem does not permanently pause cloud saving.
  • Added an online-reconnect handler so queued local changes retry automatically as soon as the device regains internet access.
  • Kept conflict protection intact: only a genuine newer-cloud-version conflict pauses automatic sync and asks the user which copy to keep.
  • Automatic cloud configuration remains locked into the build, and only Arnold’s creator account can use the owner-only force-replace action.
  • No CNA assignment distribution, workload, staffing, Review / Finalize, History, print, theme, or Catered Cottage branding logic changed.
v4.7.0 · Automatic Secure Cloud Sign-In
  • Built the Catered Cottage Supabase Project URL, publishable key, and workspace slug directly into the app so a new device no longer requires manual Supabase setup.
  • Added a secure cloud sign-in gate: approved users enter only their email and password, and a fresh device automatically loads the existing cloud workspace when it has no meaningful unsynced local data.
  • Locked automatic cloud saving on after sync while preserving immediate local saving and the existing conflict-protection behavior that pauses instead of silently overwriting newer cloud data.
  • Removed editable Project URL, API key, and workspace fields from Settings so supervisors cannot accidentally redirect or break the cloud connection.
  • Added membership-backed cloud authorization. Arnold’s current account is the creator/owner; future users must be explicitly added as creator, supervisor, or viewer before the database will allow access.
  • Restricted the force-replace “Upload This Device” control to the creator/owner interface. Normal approved supervisor changes can still auto-sync to the shared workspace.
  • No CNA assignment distribution, light-load calculations, Ordered Reassignment, Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, break rotation, Review / Finalize, History, print calculations, or Catered Cottage branding logic changed.
v4.6.4 · Fixed Catered Cottage Brand Logo
  • Changed the Catered Cottage logo/app mark to stay gold with black details across every interface theme instead of changing to blue, teal/green, or slate.
  • Theme choices now affect interface accents, tabs, buttons, and highlights only; company branding remains visually consistent.
  • Applied the fixed brand treatment to the top header, desktop sidebar, and secure-access screen.

  • No assignment distribution, Review / Finalize workflow, theme-setting behavior, History, cloud sync, security, or print calculations changed.

  • Wrapped the topbar branding rules in a proper screen style block so the logo renders normally and the CSS is no longer visible to supervisors.
  • Preserved the theme-aware Catered Cottage top-left mark introduced in v4.6.2.
