v4.6.2 · Themed Topbar Logo
  • Added a compact Catered Cottage app mark to the top-left header so the workspace branding is visible even when the desktop sidebar is hidden or the app is used in Simple View.
  • The new top-left brand mark automatically follows the active color theme, so Gold, Clinical Blue, Calm Teal, and Neutral Slate now stay visually consistent across the header branding.
  • Kept the mark compact and screen-friendly so the header feels more polished without crowding the Generate / Review / Finalize workflow controls.
  • Updated visible version labels and metadata to v4.6.2.
  • No assignment distribution, review checks, finalization rules, History, theme settings, cloud sync, security, or print calculations changed.
v4.6.1 · Review Start Focus Fix
  • Changed the Review & Finalize Shift action so it opens Review at Assignment Status—the beginning of the review workflow—instead of jumping down to the final assignment preview or Finalize button.
  • Added a clear focus target for Assignment Status so supervisors immediately see the validation checks, coverage information, break details, Observation / Sitter status, and hospital information first.
  • The collapsible generated-assignment Final Check remains farther down the Review page directly above Finalize & Save Shift for the last visual verification.
  • This change applies in both Simple View and Full View and preserves the existing Generate behavior.
  • No assignment distribution, light-load calculations, Ordered Reassignment, Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, break rotation, finalization rules, History, themes, cloud sync, security, or print calculations changed.
v4.6.0 · Review-First Finalization Flow
  • Reordered Review & Finalize so assignment status, coverage checks, break information, Observation / Sitter coverage, hospital status, and call-off tools appear before the final assignment preview.
  • Converted the read-only generated assignment preview into a collapsible Final Check section positioned directly above Finalize & Save Shift.
  • The Final Check opens automatically after a fresh Generate so new supervisors see it, but it can be collapsed to keep Review compact after it has been checked.
  • Explicitly corrected the Review grid structure so the preview and finalization controls render consistently across desktop, iPad, and mobile layouts.
  • Preserved the prominent Generate → Review → Finalize workflow and all existing theme, typography, print, and accessibility settings.
  • No assignment distribution, light-load calculations, Ordered Reassignment, Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, break rotation, finalization rules, History, cloud sync, security, or print calculations changed.
v4.5.0 · Readable Default Typography
  • Increased the Standard on-screen text size across the supervisor workspace so the default view is easier to read without requiring an accessibility override.
  • Enlarged common small text including room and bed labels, assignment details, status chips, buttons, field labels, helper text, Review content, Settings descriptions, break information, workload advisories, and shift statistics.
  • Rebalanced Large and Extra Large App Text Size so both remain meaningful accessibility steps above the new, more readable Standard size.
  • Kept mobile layouts responsive with slightly tighter scaling on narrow screens to reduce clipping and unnecessary wrapping.
  • Print Text Size remains independent; this release changes screen typography only.
  • No assignment distribution, light-load calculations, Ordered Reassignment, Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, break rotation, finalization, History, cloud sync, security, or print calculations changed.
v4.4.0 · Theme Choices & Final Review Preview
  • Added four professional color themes under Settings → Display & Printing: Catered Cottage Gold, Clinical Blue, Calm Teal, and Neutral Slate.
  • Theme selection is a local-device display preference, so changing colors does not alter shared census, assignments, finalized History, or another supervisor’s preferred appearance.
  • Kept status meaning consistent across every theme: green remains success/finalized, amber remains caution/observation, and red remains a true warning/problem color.
  • Added a read-only copy of the generated CNA assignment directly inside Review & Finalize so supervisors can verify the exact room assignments immediately before finalizing.
  • The review preview updates whenever assignments are generated or rebalanced and clearly changes to Finalized Assignment after the shift is saved.
  • No assignment distribution, light-load calculations, Ordered Reassignment, Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, break rotation, finalization rules, cloud data, security, or print calculations changed.
v4.3.0 · Workflow Action Cleanup
  • Removed the duplicate Generate Again button beside Generate Assignments because both controls performed the same generation action.
  • Kept one Generate control and made its label change automatically: Generate Assignments before a draft exists, then Generate Again after an assignment has been created.
  • Updated the mobile Generate action to use the same state-aware wording so the interface stays consistent.
  • Removed the duplicate Full View shortcut from More because the Simple / Full switch in the header is already the primary view control.
  • Kept the Interface mode preference in Settings so supervisors can still choose and save their preferred workspace mode.
  • No assignment distribution, light-load calculations, Ordered Reassignment, Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, break rotation, finalization, history, cloud, security, or print calculations changed.
v4.2.0 · Catered Cottage Brand Refresh
  • Reworked the interface around Catered Cottage’s gold-and-black visual identity using warm gold accents, charcoal typography, white surfaces, and a softer neutral workspace background.
  • Changed primary workflow emphasis from generic clinical blue to brand gold while preserving semantic colors: green for finalized/success, amber for caution/observation, and red for true problems.
  • Refined Full View navigation, Shift Prep, cards, tabs, focus states, buttons, and the post-Generate Review & Finalize banner so the workspace feels more cohesive and less visually busy.
  • Kept Automatic shift preparation inside Settings and retained the prominent Generate → Review & Finalize → Finalize & Save Shift workflow introduced in v4.1.0.
  • Updated app branding surfaces, version labels, print footer version, lock-screen version, backup/version metadata, and feedback diagnostics to v4.2.0.
  • No assignment distribution, light-load calculations, Ordered Reassignment, Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, break rotation, history, cloud, security, or print calculations changed.
v4.1.0 · Clear Finalization Workflow & Refined Design
  • Added a prominent Review & Finalize Shift action immediately after assignments are generated so supervisors know Generate is not the last step.
  • Strengthened the final completion action to Finalize & Save Shift and made finalization visually distinct from printing.
  • Refined Full View to a cohesive healthcare palette using white, slate, and clinical blue with green reserved for successful finalization and semantic status colors only where needed.
  • Kept Automatic shift targeting consolidated in Settings to reduce Full View crowding.
  • No assignment distribution, light-load, sitter, shower, break, history, cloud, security, or print calculations changed.
v3.8.4 · Mobile Navigation Spacing
  • Separated the Simple View tabs more clearly so Assignment and Review no longer read like one combined label on iPhone widths.
  • Uses the shorter “Assign” label on narrow screens while keeping “Assignment” on wider screens.
  • Added subtle separators and spacing between tabs without changing any workflow or assignment logic.
v3.8.2 · QA Cleanup & Light-Load Rebalance Protection
  • Fixed the mobile bottom Generate button so Simple View moves directly to the Assignment tab after a successful generation.
  • Improved CNA Leaves Early redistribution so existing light-load preferences remain protected when the departing residents can be absorbed by standard assignments.
  • Made Day Shift Shower Team compact by default in Simple View; the supervisor can tap Edit to expand it while Full View remains fully visible.
  • Kept the v3.8.1 More Shift Details visibility fix and corrected Version History so v3.8.0, v3.8.1, and v3.8.2 are listed separately.
  • No cloud-schema, census-status, print timestamp, Observation / Sitter, or Care Load data format changes.
v3.8.1 · More Shift Details Fix
  • Fixed Simple View More Shift Details opening without revealing Observation, Expected Admissions, At Hospital, and Vacant Beds.
  • Added a clearer expand/collapse indicator while leaving assignment logic unchanged.
v3.8.0 · Compact Simple / Full Workspace
  • Introduced a true compact Simple View with tabbed Shift, Census, Staff, Assignment, and Review screens so supervisors no longer scroll through unrelated sections.
  • Kept Full View for experienced users who prefer the richer all-at-once workspace and made the Simple / Full switch available directly in the header.
  • History and Settings remain separate utility screens under More in Simple View, while prediction, break configuration, cloud sync, security, backups, and other advanced controls stay tucked away.
  • Added print lifecycle timestamps: Generated before finalization, original Finalized time after finalization, and a Reprinted time when printing an older History copy.
  • Made interface/display preferences local-device preferences so future cloud sync will not force one supervisor’s Simple/Full choice onto another device.
  • Preserved assignment generation, light-load math, Ordered Reassignment, Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, Care Load, History, cloud groundwork, and existing data.
v3.5.21 · Light-Load Final Target Fix
  • Fixed a remaining light-load edge case where “1 fewer” could still end two residents below the larger standard assignments when the census had a remainder.
  • Light Load now uses the normal rounded-up workload as its reference: for example, 75 residents / 6 CNAs has a normal ceiling of 13, so “1 fewer” targets 12.
  • The Workload Advisory “Set −1” action is idempotent and cannot stack another reduction onto an assignment that is already set to −1 or −2.
  • Preserved fair remainder rotation, room/bed order, Care Load scoring, sitter-relief advisory, early-leave Ordered Reassignment, break rotation, Shower Team, and Observation/Sitter behavior.
v3.5.20 · Adjustable App Text Size
  • Added a separate App Text Size preference with Standard, Large, and Extra Large options for supervisors who need larger on-screen letters and numbers.
  • The setting enlarges room/bed labels, assignment counts, buttons, status text, workload advisories, settings, break information, and other small interface text while keeping Print Text Size independent.
  • Added wrapping/minimum-height safeguards so larger text is less likely to clip on iPhone, iPad, or desktop layouts.
  • No changes to Generate, light-load math, Care Load scoring, early-leave Ordered Reassignment, Observation/Sitter, Shower Team, or break rules.
v3.5.19 · Simplified Settings
  • Reorganized Settings into expandable sections so less-frequently used options stay hidden until needed.
  • General Settings stays open by default; Break Rotation, Display & Printing, Supervisor Access & Security, Data/Backup/Maintenance, and Help/Feedback start collapsed.
  • Kept all existing setting IDs and behavior intact so saved preferences and event handlers continue to work.
  • No changes to Generate, light-load math, Care Load scoring, early-leave Ordered Reassignment, Observation/Sitter, Shower Team, or break-time rules.
v3.5.18 · Light-Load Guardrail & Feedback
  • Added a recommended maximum of two lighter assignments per shift. Selecting a third or more requires explicit supervisor override confirmation and displays a visible warning.
  • Care Load/dependency points remain advisory and help identify which assignments are the best candidates for the limited light-load slots.
  • Added an in-app Suggestion / Bug Report form with optional technical details and a Copy Report fallback.
  • Added a privacy reminder not to include resident names, diagnoses, medications, or other private health information in feedback.
  • No changes to core resident sequencing, light-load target math, early-leave Ordered Reassignment, Observation/Sitter, Shower Team, or break-time calculations.
v3.5.17 · Break Rotation Layout Fix
  • Fixed the Settings page responsive cascade that could leave settings in two columns on an iPhone/iPad-sized viewport.
  • Made Break Rotation span the full settings width so its time controls no longer overlap the Display & accessibility card.
  • On narrow screens, Break Rotation now stacks one time field per row and forces native time inputs to stay inside the card.
  • Added Restore Facility Break Times for the confirmed 11:00/11:30 AM, 7:00/7:30 PM, and 3:00/3:30 AM schedule, plus HTML fallback values so iPhone file preview does not show the current clock time in an uninitialized field.
  • No assignment, light-load, early-leave, care-load, Observation / Sitter, or Shower Team logic changed.
v3.5.16 · Optional Care Load & Workload Advisory
  • Added optional per-resident Care Load levels: Independent / Low, Moderate Assistance, High Assistance, and Total Dependent / Very Heavy.
  • Added optional workload factors for long toileting, lengthy transfers, frequent changes, frequent call-light assistance, high ADL assistance, frequent repositioning, and other time-consuming care.
  • Added assignment-level Workload Advisory highlighting. It combines entered care burden with the facility rule that Assignment 1 and the last regular assignment typically lose about 30 minutes covering the Observation / Sitter break.
  • Workload hints are advisory only; the supervisor can decide whether to keep the assignment or select a −1/−2 lighter load. Resident ratings remain optional and never block Generate.
  • Care ratings persist in local storage/backups, are included in census Undo/Redo and finalized snapshots, and are automatically cleared when a bed is marked Vacant.
v3.5.15 · Night Break Time Correction
  • Corrected the facility Night Shift break schedule to 3:00 AM for the first/odd Assignment group and 3:30 AM for the second/even Assignment group.
  • Updated Break Settings, assignment-card break badges, Review, Print, copied assignment text, finalized History, and backup defaults to the corrected schedule.
  • Automatically migrates the v3.5.14 default pair of 3:30 AM / 4:00 AM to 3:00 AM / 3:30 AM, including the active saved draft, so the incorrect one-release default does not persist after updating.
  • No assignment, light-load, early-leave, Observation / Sitter, or Shower Team logic was changed.
v3.5.14 · Night Break Schedule
  • Introduced Night Shift break defaults as 3:30 AM / 4:00 AM based on an initial misunderstanding of the facility schedule.
  • These times were corrected in v3.5.15 to 3:00 AM / 3:30 AM.
v3.5.13 · Shower Team & Break Rotation
  • Added a separate Day Shift Shower Team section with Shower Lead (SL) and editable shower-team CNA members; names remain optional and do not change regular room-assignment workload.
  • Added facility break rotation by Assignment number: odd-numbered assignments are first-break group and even-numbered assignments are second-break group.
  • Configured Day defaults to 11:00 AM / 11:30 AM and Evening defaults to 7:00 PM / 7:30 PM. Night times remain unset until the facility times are confirmed.
  • Added break badges to assignment cards plus Shower Team and Break Schedule to Review, print handoff, copied assignment text, finalized History, backup/restore, and audit logging.
  • Updated stale version labels throughout the interface.
v3.5.12 · CNA-Only Observation Coverage
  • Removed PSA from Observation / Sitter coverage because the facility now uses CNA coverage only.
  • Removed the role selector from the Observation / Sitter editor; coverage is always CNA.
  • Older saved PSA observation coverage automatically migrates to CNA while preserving the optional staff name and assigned/unassigned state.
  • Regular CNA assignment names and Observation / Sitter names remain optional.
v3.5.11 · Early-Leave Fair Remainder Fix
  • Fixed Ordered Reassignment always favoring the lowest Assignment number when multiple remaining CNAs were equally eligible for an extra resident.
  • When “Rotate extras fairly” is ON, early-leave remainder residents are now distributed among tied assignments instead of always starting with Assignment 1.
  • When “Extras by assignment order” is selected, the lower Assignment number intentionally wins the tie.
  • Strict forward room/bed sequence is preserved; only the recipient block sizes change.
v3.5.10 · Light Assignment Target Fix
  • Fixed a remainder-distribution bug where a CNA set to “Lighter assignment · 1 fewer” could receive two fewer residents when that assignment had already been selected for the naturally smaller fair-share remainder.
  • Light-load targets are now calculated as part of the fairness model from the beginning instead of subtracting again after ordinary remainder assignment.
  • Verified 76 residents across 7 assignments with Assignment 7 set to 1 fewer produces 11, 11, 11, 11, 11, 11, 10.
  • Preserved room/bed ordering, optional names, Observation / Sitter coverage, prediction, history, PIN access, and ordered early-leave reassignment.
v3.5.9 · Desktop Staff Width & Observation Fit
  • Widened the desktop Staff workspace so Observation / Sitter controls are no longer forced into an undersized side column.
  • Stacks Census and Staff sooner on medium desktop/tablet widths instead of squeezing both panels side-by-side.
  • Added hard width/min-width safeguards to the Observation / Sitter panel and compact responsive controls for large desktop widths.
  • Mobile behavior and assignment logic are unchanged.
v3.5.8 · Desktop Observation Layout Fix
  • Fixed the Observation / Sitter editor overflowing or feeling cramped inside the narrower desktop Staff panel.
  • Desktop now lays each observation room out as Room header → Name + Role → Coverage controls/status, while preserving the existing mobile stacked layout.
  • Added min-width and overflow safeguards so long labels, buttons, and optional staff names cannot force the Staff card wider than its desktop column.
  • No assignment, sitter, prediction, history, or early-leave logic was changed in this release.
v3.5.7 · Observation Placeholder Cleanup
  • Fixed legacy Observation / Sitter labels such as “Observation / Sitter Team” and “Observer 4” being displayed as if they were staff names.
  • Added migration cleanup across the active sitter coverage, saved current draft, and finalized History snapshots so placeholder labels cannot return after a reload.
  • Unnamed CNA/PSA observation coverage remains valid and displays consistently as “name not entered.”
  • Preserved all v3.5.6 assignment-engine, ordered early-leave reassignment, optional-name, prediction, finalization, and history behavior.
v3.5.6 · Assignment Engine Restoration & QA
  • Fixed a v3.5.5 regression that accidentally removed core assignment-engine functions, causing Residents to Assign / Target per CNA to show incorrectly and preventing Generate from producing assignments.
  • Restored generation, assignment rendering, fair target calculation, print/copy helpers, workload invalidation, and ordered call-off helper functions from the last known-good engine.
  • Regression-tested census counters, Generate, blank CNA names, Observation / Sitter coverage, light-load rules, ordered early-leave reassignment, Undo/Redo, staffing prediction, draft persistence, finalization/history, and responsive layout.
  • Renamed the vague Facility actions control to Bulk Census Actions for clarity; behavior remains protected by confirmation.
v3.5.5 · Optional Staff Names
  • Made CNA names optional for regular Assignment 1, Assignment 2, and all other CNA runs; blank names never block generation, review, finalization, or printing.
  • Made Observation / Sitter names optional. Supervisors can assign CNA or PSA coverage to an observation room even when no staff name is entered.
  • Observation coverage uses an explicit assigned state, so a blank name can still represent valid assigned CNA/PSA coverage and prints cleanly by role.
  • Assignment Review warns only when an observation room has no coverage assignment at all, not when the assigned sitter name is blank.
v3.5.4 · Single Observation / Sitter Workflow
  • Removed the legacy Observation group / Observer 1–10 dropdown from the Census room editor.
  • Census now only marks beds as Observation; sitter staffing is entered in one place under Staff → Observation / Sitter.
  • Sitter staffing uses a type-ahead staff name field plus CNA/PSA role, while Observation Rooms remain read-only status information in Assignment Review.
v3.5.2 · Print Observation Cleanup
  • Removed the duplicate Observation Rooms block from the printed CNA handoff.
  • Kept only the observation staffing section on print and renamed it to Observation / Sitter.
  • Observation room status tracking remains available inside the workspace and Assignment Review without cluttering the printed handoff.
v3.5.1 · Sequential Fair-Split Correction
  • Clarified and enforced Ordered Reassignment as a strict forward bed sequence: the departing CNA's residents are sorted by room/bed and never skipped or revisited.
  • Fair final resident counts take priority over keeping a room together, so natural boundaries such as 26C → 27A are allowed when that produces the correct split.
  • Added an internal sequence-integrity check so an ordered preview cannot be produced if the redistributed blocks do not exactly match the sorted departing-resident list.
v3.5.0 · Ordered Reassignment & Observation Team
  • Replaced the default call-off logic with Ordered Reassignment: only the departing CNA's residents move, sorted strictly by room/bed and divided into consecutive blocks across the remaining Assignment numbers.
  • Final resident counts are balanced first, then the departing beds are split in strict room/bed sequence across consecutive recipient blocks.
  • Added a visible Observation / Sitter section with staff name and CNA/PSA role for every room currently marked Observation.
  • Observation coverage remains separate from regular CNA workload and is included on the final handoff/print and finalized History snapshot.
  • Added Assignment Review coverage checks for observation rooms.
v3.4.0 · Room-Order Call-Off Rebalance & Print Cleanup
  • Added two call-off rebalance styles: Room Order (recommended) and Minimal Changes.
  • Room Order rebuilds surviving runs in geographic room order while keeping same-room bed pairs together when practical and preserving surviving Assignment numbers.
  • Minimal Changes retains the previous room-first behavior that redistributes only the departing CNA’s residents whenever possible.
  • Expanded the rebalance preview to show residents received and released when room boundaries change.
  • Cleaned the normal print handoff so History and administrative sections never appear on the CNA assignment printout.
v3.3.0 · Predictive Staffing, Finalize & History
  • Added CNA Directory with name autocomplete, usual workdays, usual Day/Evening/Night shift, preferred assignment/run, and active/inactive status.
  • Added editable staffing predictions from saved routines and finalized assignment history.
  • Added Finalize Shift protection, durable current-draft saving, finalized assignment history, reprintable snapshots, and an append-style audit/change log.
  • Added display-size, print-size, contrast, typical staffing, backup/import, and safer current-assignment controls.
  • Expanded Smart Rebalance preview with before/after impact details while preserving room-first redistribution.
v3.2.0 · Room-First Rebalance & Creator Access
  • Removed legacy room-list abbreviations such as OCC/OBS/ADM/OHP/EMP and replaced them with readable status labels.
  • Fixed the desktop Shift Override control so it cannot clip or fall into an unintended grid column.
  • Rebuilt Smart Rebalance to redistribute by room group first, keeping adjacent beds such as 18A + 18B together whenever possible before splitting a room.
  • Improved the Smart Rebalance preview to show reassigned beds grouped by room.
  • Added a separate Creator Master PIN recovery path that can unlock the workspace and authorize supervisor PIN reset/disable.
v3.1.0 · Brand, Navigation & Supervisor Access
  • Replaced the oversized dark desktop sidebar with a compact light navigation rail and active-step highlighting.
  • Introduced a purpose-built CNA Assignment app mark combining a cottage, checklist, and completed-task check badge; it complements rather than replaces Catered Cottage’s official facility logo.
  • Made Shift Prep more compact and work-focused instead of using a large landing-page banner.
  • Added optional local device PIN access, one-click Lock, and configurable inactivity auto-lock.
  • Added keyboard room-search shortcut (/) and improved desktop/mobile navigation polish.
v3.0.1 · Terminology & Clarity Update
  • Standardized resident/bed statuses to Resident Present, Observation, Expected Admission, Hospital, and Vacant throughout the supervisor interface.
  • Reworded workload and fairness labels to clearer supervisor-facing terms such as Residents to Assign, Target / CNA, Fair Remainder Assignment, and Assignment Review.
  • Improved Smart Rebalance, validation, print, filter, and facility-action wording without changing saved internal status values or assignment logic.
v3.0.0 · Supervisor Workspace Redesign
  • New professional sidebar/workspace design while preserving Catered Cottage room/status and assignment rules.
  • Automatic upcoming-shift targeting during normal 1–3 hour preparation windows.
  • Outside prep windows, automatic mode shows the currently active shift instead of guessing the next shift.
  • Cleaner Shift Prep → Census → Staff → Assignments → Review & Print workflow.
  • v2.0.0 saved census/staff/settings automatically migrate into v3.
  • Smart Rebalance, light-load rules, coverage validation, print options, and Arnold Deveney creator credit retained.
v2.0.0 · Professional Modernization
  • Introduced Smart Rebalance, coverage validation, saved CNA names, modern room statuses, and formal version history.

DSD Shift Planner

Prepare Day, Evening, or Night for any selected date
✓ NO TIME RESTRICTION
Prepare whenever DSD needs to: there is no clock-based or advance-date lock. DSD can make an assignment for today, tomorrow, several days ahead, or farther ahead, then return to that saved date/shift later to update call-offs or replacements. Automatic shift windows elsewhere in CareOps are suggestions only. For Night · 11 PM–7 AM, the patient-day date is the date the shift starts at 11 PM.
Late call-off after DSD leaves: CareOps keeps the assignment/state-paper version that DSD issued. If someone calls off later, document the change on the printed paper according to your facility/DON policy (for example, cross out the absent employee, write the replacement and actual times/assignment, and have the replacement sign). The app does not pretend that a later handwritten change was made by DSD.

ONE-TIME STAFF INVITE

Join Cottage CareOps

Enter the 6-digit invite code from your administrator and your real staff/roster name. The name must match the invite so Cottage CareOps can automatically match you to the CNA Directory and finalized assignments.

Your invite code is single-use and expires automatically. Your real staff name becomes your Cottage CareOps display name and is automatically available to supervisors for roster matching. After your first successful sign-in, you will choose a personal 4–8 digit PIN for quick access on this device.

Nursing Monthly Schedule

DON / ADON calendar · schedule-driven daily staffing
Schedule ownership: the official nursing monthly calendar is normally maintained by the DON or ADON. DSD/Scheduler can view this calendar and use its names in the DSD Shift Planner, but the calendar itself remains unchanged when DSD records a call-off, replacement, moved shift, or extra/called-in staff member.
